Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel sigma algebra; rank zero is allowed. Let alpha,beta be nonnegative reals, eta real and V:E->R. Assume alpha>0, alpha<=beta, V is C2, alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for all x,v, eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. No additional dynamical, probability, density, integrability or independence hypothesis is supplied.
For every y,r in E put c=y-eta grad V(r). Define Phi_u(x,p)=(c+cos(u)(x-c)+sqrt(eta)sin(u)p, -sin(u)/sqrt(eta)(x-c)+cos(u)p). Set h_r(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p-(2<p,h_r(x)>/||h_r(x)||^2)h_r(x)), lambda_r(x,p)=sqrt(eta)max(0,<p,h_r(x)>), and Lambda_z(u)=integral_0^u lambda_r(Phi_s(z))ds for u>=0. Division by zero is totalized by zero, so zero normal leaves the velocity unchanged. The Lebesgue interval integral uses the real time coordinate.
Let P be the countable product of unit-rate real exponential probability measures, on real clock streams w; set epsilon_j(w)=max(w_j,0). For each phase z and threshold e>=0 define tau_z(e)=inf{u>=0:Lambda_z(u)>=e}, with value infinity if the set is empty. The source recursion starts with record_0=live(0,z0). From live(a,z), threshold epsilon_j gives stopped if tau_z(epsilon_j)=infinity and otherwise live(a+tau_z(epsilon_j),S_r(Phi_tau(z))); stopped remains stopped. Event time T_j is the time in a live record and infinity in a stopped record. Let I_j(s)={T_j<=s<T_(j+1)}.
For n>=0 and T>=0 let Delta_n(T)={0<t1<...<tn<T}. Its measure m_n is the comap of Fin-n product Lebesgue measure under the subtype inclusion. Set a0=0, ai=ti, z_i=S_r(Phi_(a_i-a_(i-1))(z_(i-1))) and K_n(t)_j=live(a_j,z_j), j=0,...,n. For any tagged history h, the total interpolation Psi_n(h)(s), 0<=s<=T, starts from z0 and scans j in increasing order: live(a,z) with a<=s replaces the accumulator by Phi_(max(s-a,0))(z); every other record leaves it unchanged. Let Gamma_n(t)=Psi_n(K_n(t)). In particular a jump time carries the post-reflection phase. Path_T is the set of all phase-valued functions on[0,T], with its coordinate-product sigma algebra; no Skorokhod or supremum-norm Borel identification is asserted.
Define the real weight w_n(t)=exp(-integral_0^T lambda_r(Gamma_n(t)(min(max(s,0),T)))ds) times product_(i=1)^n lambda_r(Phi_(a_i-a_(i-1))(z_(i-1))). The clamp is only the real-time extension used by the integral; it agrees with the path coordinate on[0,T]. Every bounce factor uses the incoming phase, and the whole-path integral includes the final no-event arc. Empty products are1; the n=0 simplex is the singleton empty tuple.
There exists one phase process Z(y,r,z0,s,w), jointly measurable in all displayed arguments. On every raw stream belonging to I_n(s) whose nth record is live(a,z), its value is exactly Phi_(max(s-a,0))(z). If no covering I_n(s) exists, its value is z0. For every fixed y,r,z0 it equals z0 at time0 P-almost surely. These clauses bind the witness to the literal stopped-clock process, including exceptional raw streams; no arbitrary process with a convenient distribution may replace it.
For all deterministic y,r,z0,T, write Z_T(w)(s)=Z(y,r,z0,s,w). For every measurable real F:Path_T->R and every M>=0 such that |F(p)|<=M for every path p, F(Z_T) is P-integrable, every real function t->F(Gamma_n(t))w_n(t) is m_n-integrable, the series sum_n |integral_Delta_n F(Gamma_n(t))w_n(t)dm_n| converges, and
integral F(Z_T(w))dP(w)=sum_(n=0)^infinity integral_Delta_n(T) F(Gamma_n(t))w_n(t)dm_n(t).
The statement includes n=0,T=0,rank0,zero rates and stopped/infinite waits. Fixed deterministic parameters and horizon precede the almost-sure statements and integration. Coordinate-product measurability and null-input fallback are explicit ASTIS completions. The source all-count bounded-real A7 identity is realized through the probability-mass partition; the printed uniform rate-cap/factorial domination remains a separate source proof route, not an added premise. No unbounded-test or cost transfer, path-space topology equivalence, restart/Markovness, invariance, hypocoercivity, implementation error, main sampling theorem or actual-input composition is claimed.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun w k => Real.toNNReal (w k)
    let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
    let Hist : ℕ → Type _ := fun n => Fin (n + 1) → Rec
    let Δ : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Set (Fin n → ℝ) := fun n T =>
      {t | StrictMono (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) t) ∧ ∀ i, t i < (T : ℝ)}
    let Prefix : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Type := fun n T => {t : Fin n → ℝ // t ∈ Δ n T}
    let m : (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Measure (Prefix n T) := fun n T =>
      Measure.comap (fun t : Prefix n T => t.val) (volume : Measure (Fin n → ℝ))
    let zAt : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → Fin (n + 1) → (E × E) := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
      Fin.induction z₀ (fun i z =>
        S xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc) z))
    let K : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → Hist n := fun y xRef z₀ n T t j =>
      Sum.inl (Real.toNNReal ((Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j), zAt y xRef z₀ n T t j)
    let eventTime : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef z₀ w j => (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j).elim
        (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
    let I : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℕ → Set (ℕ → ℝ) :=
      fun y xRef z₀ T n => {w | eventTime y xRef z₀ w n ≤ (T : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
        (T : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ w (n + 1)}
    let Path : ℝ≥0 → Type _ := fun T => {s : ℝ≥0 // s ≤ T} → E × E
    let Ψ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Hist n → Path T :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T h s =>
        Fin.foldl (n + 1) (fun z j => (h j).elim
          (fun a => if a.1 ≤ s.val then Φ y xRef ((s.val - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2 else z)
          (fun _ => z)) z₀
    let Γ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Prefix n T → Path T :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T t => Ψ y xRef z₀ n T (K y xRef z₀ n T t)
    let wgt : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Prefix n T → ℝ :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
        Real.exp (-(∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(T : ℝ),
          rate xRef (Γ y xRef z₀ n T t ⟨min (Real.toNNReal s) T, min_le_right _ _⟩))) *
        ∏ i : Fin n,
          rate xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i -
            (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc)
            (zAt y xRef z₀ n T t i.castSucc))
    ∃ Z : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → (ℕ → ℝ) → (E × E),
      Measurable (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 × (ℕ → ℝ) =>
        Z a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ w : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ s : ℝ≥0,
        ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E), w ∈ I y xRef z₀ s n →
          record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n = Sum.inl a →
          Z y xRef z₀ s w = Φ y xRef ((s - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ w : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ s : ℝ≥0,
        (¬ ∃ n, w ∈ I y xRef z₀ s n) → Z y xRef z₀ s w = z₀) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ᵐ w ∂P, Z y xRef z₀ 0 w = z₀) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ T : ℝ≥0,
        let ZT : (ℕ → ℝ) → Path T := fun u s => Z y xRef z₀ s.val u
        ∀ F : Path T → ℝ, Measurable F → ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M →
          (∀ p : Path T, |F p| ≤ M) →
          Integrable (fun u => F (ZT u)) P ∧
          (∀ n : ℕ, Integrable (fun t : Prefix n T =>
            F (Γ y xRef z₀ n T t) * wgt y xRef z₀ n T t) (m n T)) ∧
          Summable (fun n : ℕ => |∫ t : Prefix n T,
            F (Γ y xRef z₀ n T t) * wgt y xRef z₀ n T t ∂m n T|) ∧
          (∫ u, F (ZT u) ∂P) = ∑' n : ℕ, ∫ t : Prefix n T,
            F (Γ y xRef z₀ n T t) * wgt y xRef z₀ n T t ∂m n T)
decoder_context: The ambient norm and inner product are real; gradient and fderiv denote Hilbert gradient and Frechet derivative. The indicated measurable structure on the ambient space is Borel.
A function space has the coordinate-product sigma algebra. Measurable therefore refers to that sigma algebra; no path-space topology is implicitly supplied.

Measure.infinitePi is the countable product measure. expMeasure(1) is the real unit-rate exponential law. Measure.comap under a measurable subtype inclusion is the restriction pulled back to that subtype; volume on a finite real-coordinate product is product Lebesgue measure.
hittingAfter at0 is the infimum of nonnegative hitting times, with top when the hitting set is empty. WithTop adjoins infinity; untopD returns the finite value or its specified default at top.

Fin n lists integers0 through n-1. Fin.cons prepends a value; castSucc preserves the numeric index. Fin.induction recursively constructs a finite indexed family. Fin.foldl visits indices in increasing order.
Sum.inl and Sum.inr are distinct tags; Unit has one element. Nonnegative subtraction truncates at zero. Real.toNNReal(x)=max(x,0), and real division by zero equals zero.

Integrable is Bochner integrability, including absolute integrability for real functions. Summable and tsum use the ordinary unconditional sum; over real sequences this entails absolute convergence. AE quantifiers refer only to their displayed measure.
Empty finite products are1. All universal quantifiers retain their ordinary scope, including zero-dimensional ambient spaces and empty subtypes.

private theorem signed_sector
    {X U J Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace U]
    [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure U} {H : X → J} {Z : X → Y}
    {K : U → J} {Γ : U → Y} {ρ : U → ℝ≥0∞} {wgt : U → ℝ}
    (hH : Measurable H) (hZ : Measurable Z) (hK : Measurable K)
    (hΓ : Measurable Γ) (hρ : Measurable ρ)
    (hw : ∀ t, 0 ≤ wgt t) (heq : ∀ t, ρ t = ENNReal.ofReal (wgt t))
    (hlaw : Measure.map (fun x => (H x, Z x)) μ =
      Measure.map (fun t => (K t, Γ t)) (ν.withDensity ρ))
    {F : Y → ℝ} (hF : Measurable F) (hi : Integrable (fun x => F (Z x)) μ) :
    Integrable (fun t => F (Γ t) * wgt t) ν ∧
      (∫ x, F (Z x) ∂μ) = ∫ t, F (Γ t) * wgt t ∂ν := by
  have hG : Measurable (fun q : J × Y => F q.2) := hF.comp measurable_snd
  have hiMap : Integrable (fun q : J × Y => F q.2)
      (Measure.map (fun x => (H x, Z x)) μ) :=
    (integrable_map_measure hG.aestronglyMeasurable
      (hH.prodMk hZ).aemeasurable).2 hi
  rw [hlaw] at hiMap
  have hiW : Integrable (fun t => F (Γ t)) (ν.withDensity ρ) :=
    (integrable_map_measure hG.aestronglyMeasurable
      (hK.prodMk hΓ).aemeasurable).1 hiMap
  have htop : ∀ᵐ t ∂ν, ρ t < ⊤ := Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    (fun t => by rw [heq]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)

    rw [heq, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hw t)]

      (integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul' hρ htop).1 hiW
  · calc
      (∫ x, F (Z x) ∂μ) = ∫ q : J × Y, F q.2
          ∂Measure.map (fun x => (H x, Z x)) μ :=
        (integral_map (hH.prodMk hZ).aemeasurable hG.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
      _ = ∫ q : J × Y, F q.2
          ∂Measure.map (fun t => (K t, Γ t)) (ν.withDensity ρ) := by rw [hlaw]
      _ = ∫ t, F (Γ t) ∂ν.withDensity ρ :=
        integral_map (hK.prodMk hΓ).aemeasurable hG.aestronglyMeasurable
      _ = ∫ t, F (Γ t) * wgt t ∂ν := by
        simpa only [hreal, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using
          integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul hρ htop (fun t => F (Γ t))

Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel sigma algebra; rank zero is allowed. Let alpha,beta be nonnegative reals, eta real and V:E->R. Assume alpha>0, alpha<=beta, V is C2, alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for all x,v, eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. No additional dynamical, probability, density, integrability or independence hypothesis is supplied.
For every y,r in E put c=y-eta grad V(r). Define Phi_u(x,p)=(c+cos(u)(x-c)+sqrt(eta)sin(u)p, -sin(u)/sqrt(eta)(x-c)+cos(u)p). Set h_r(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p-(2<p,h_r(x)>/||h_r(x)||^2)h_r(x)), lambda_r(x,p)=sqrt(eta)max(0,<p,h_r(x)>), and Lambda_z(u)=integral_0^u lambda_r(Phi_s(z))ds for u>=0. Division by zero is totalized by zero, so zero normal leaves the velocity unchanged. The Lebesgue interval integral uses the real time coordinate.
Let P be the countable product of unit-rate real exponential probability measures, on real clock streams w; set epsilon_j(w)=max(w_j,0). For each phase z and threshold e>=0 define tau_z(e)=inf{u>=0:Lambda_z(u)>=e}, with value infinity if the set is empty. The source recursion starts with record_0=live(0,z0). From live(a,z), threshold epsilon_j gives stopped if tau_z(epsilon_j)=infinity and otherwise live(a+tau_z(epsilon_j),S_r(Phi_tau(z))); stopped remains stopped. Event time T_j is the time in a live record and infinity in a stopped record. Let I_j(s)={T_j<=s<T_(j+1)}.
For n>=0 and T>=0 let Delta_n(T)={0<t1<...<tn<T}. Its measure m_n is the comap of Fin-n product Lebesgue measure under the subtype inclusion. Set a0=0, ai=ti, z_i=S_r(Phi_(a_i-a_(i-1))(z_(i-1))) and K_n(t)_j=live(a_j,z_j), j=0,...,n. The expression D²V means the Frechet derivative of the derivative-valued map evaluated successively on v and v. Assume η>0 and βη≤1. Dimension zero is allowed; no third or higher derivative hypothesis is present. These are all the outer hypotheses.

Mechanical definitions.
Write r for xRef and g=∇V. For y,r∈E define c=y−ηg(r). For every a∈R and z=(x,v)∈E×E set

             −sin(a)/sqrt(η)(x−c)+cos(a)v).
For δ=g(x)−g(r), define

Division is total with zero denominator giving zero, hence S(z)=z when δ=0. The flow denominator sqrt(η) is positive by hypothesis. The intensity contains exactly sqrt(η); the trigonometric frequency in displayed time is exactly one.

For any e:N→R≥0 define the finite recursion R_0=Live(0,z0), R_(k+1)=next(y,r,e_k,R_k).
